name: Code
description: Write code in any language in a real editor with syntax highlighting. JavaScript answers can run against hidden tests in a sandbox; anything else is judged by AI against a reference and rubric.

fields.name: language
fields.description: Any language name or file extension: python, js, c++, rust, sql, haskell, ...

fields.name: reference
fields.description: A correct solution, shown after answering.

fields.name: tests
fields.description: JavaScript only: [["expression", expected], ...]. Every expression runs with the answer's code in scope; all passing is full credit.

fields.name: rubric
fields.description: What the AI grader should check when there are no tests.

instructions: Judge whether the code solves the problem correctly, using the reference and rubric. A different correct approach is correct. Syntax errors that a careful programmer would fix in seconds make it partially correct; wrong logic, missing cases the rubric asks for, or ignoring a stated constraint make it incorrect or partial. Do not grade style unless the rubric asks.
